title: Closed-form Covariance Functions in Space and Time from B-spline Spectral Densities
abstract: arXiv:2506.21953v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The autocovariance function (ACF) is central to the analysis of time series, spatial, and spatio-temporal data. Classical parametric models are often too restrictive for multivariate and space-time data, which motivates non-parametric descriptions of the ACF. Bochner's Theorem guarantees that any positive spectral measure yields a valid ACF via the inverse Fourier transform; however, existing non-parametric approaches in the spectral domain rarely return closed-form expressions for the ACF itself. We develop a closed-form class of non-parametric ACFs by deriving the inverse Fourier transform of B-spline spectral bases with arbitrary degree and knot placement. This yields a family of closed-form stationary covariance models with three properties: (i) it is uniformly dense for the ACF, among the ACFs of weakly stationary processes that possess a spectral density; (ii) it accommodates univariate, multivariate, and multidimensional

translated_title: 基于B样条谱密度的时空闭式协方差函数
translated_abstract: 自协方差函数（ACF）是时间序列、空间及时空数据分析的核心。经典参数模型对于多变量和时空数据往往过于局限，这促使了对ACF的非参数描述的需求。Bochner定理保证任何正谱测度都可以通过逆傅里叶变换得到有效的ACF；然而，现有的谱域非参数方法很少能给出ACF本身的闭式表达式。我们通过推导任意阶数和节点位置的B样条谱基的逆傅里叶变换，发展出一类闭式的非参数ACF。这产生了一族具有以下三个性质的闭式平稳协方差模型：(i) 在所有具有谱密度的弱平稳过程的ACF中，该族模型对ACF是一致稠密的；(ii) 它适用于单变量、多变量和多维情形（摘要内容在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文通过推导任意阶数和节点配置的B样条谱基的逆傅里叶变换，构建了一族闭式的非参数平稳协方差函数，该族模型在具有谱密度的弱平稳过程的自协方差函数空间中一致稠密，并能适用于单变量、多变量及多维时空数据。
